evidence: Has the Validation label and modifies UTXO view handling and parallel prevout prefetching in TestBlockValidity in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Enables parallel input prevout fetching in TestBlockValidity to reduce template validation latency and prevent cache pollution for miners and Stratum v2 services. While beneficial for template checking efficiency and downstream Stratum v2 workflows (#35671), it is reasonably deferrable as it affects block template verification rather than the core block connection or IBD validation path.
